claims.falsifier: A declared transfer or restricted response family fails adequate full-observable predictions.
claims.minimum_extra_evidence: Independent potential-combination information and full nuisance-projected rank/conditioning, not three image radii alone.

claims.statement: The ideal full-line logarithmic scalar model obeys alpha=(1+gamma) pi Vflat^2/c^2.

claims.falsifier: Calibrated dynamics/lensing disagreement with independently fixed action-owned transfer and its retained corrections.
claims.minimum_extra_evidence: Derive slip, normalization, physical Hessian/source and global/finite matching before using native lensing as a prediction test.

claims.statement: The static principal reference deficit is a fixed-radius representation of the same spherical monopole.
claims.domain: Schwarzschild static exterior r>2GM/c^2 with specified flat subtraction and areal radius.
claims.falsifier: Independently measured geometry can test the identity/domain; a transformed fitted mass is not independent evidence.
claims.minimum_extra_evidence: Independent geometrical/radius information and a valid matching model for any physical interface.

claims.statement: A specified admitted action-owned R1 state has its specified projected response.

claims.falsifier: An independently selected nonzero state disagrees with adequate full-observable data; nondetection alone does not reject a free family containing zero.
claims.minimum_extra_evidence: Independent state selection/amplitude and source-matching relation, then a calibrated observable comparison.
